data.name: Susariel
data.gender_notes: Susariel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Sariel which means 'my name is God'. Susariel may be interpreted as 'Grace of God' or 'God is my savior'. In Christian tradition, Susariel is the name of an archangel who is said to be in charge of the heavenly hosts. The name Susariel carries the meaning “Grace of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Susariel usually hope their child will grow to embody grace of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Susariel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Susariel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: סוסריאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: סוסריאל הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומורכב משני חלקים: 'סוס' שפירושו סוס, ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם סוסריאל מתפרש כ'אל הוא שומר ומגן', ומייצג את האמונה באלוהים כמגן וכשומר.

in_greek.name: Σουσαρειλ
in_greek.meaning: ο Θεός είναι φύλαξ και προστάτης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σουσαρειλ προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'σους' που σημαίνει σους και 'ελ' που σημαίνει Θεός. Το όνομα Σουσαρειλ σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι φύλαξ και προστάτης', εκφράζοντας την πίστη στον Θεό ως φύλακα και προστάτη.

in_latin.name: Susariel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Susariel originem habet in lingua hebraica et componitur ex duabus partibus: 'sus' quod significat sus et 'el' quod significat Deus. Nomen Susariel interpretatur 'Deus est custos et protector', significans fidem in Deum ut custodem et protectorem.

in_english.name: Susariel
in_english.meaning: God is the guardian and protector
in_english.long_meaning: The name Susariel originates from Hebrew roots, combining 'sus' meaning horse and 'el' meaning God. It translates to 'God is the guardian and protector', symbolizing faith in God as a shield and safeguard. Historically, Susariel may relate to angelic or biblical contexts, reflecting divine protection.

data.cultural_impact: Susariel is a name associated with ancient Jewish and Christian tradition. In Jewish history, Sariel appears as the name of an angel mentioned in the Talmud. In Christian lore, Susariel is identified as one of the seven archangels, suggesting that this name carries a rich heritage and connection to religious history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Susariel symbolizes the belief in God's power and presence in one's life. It conveys the idea that God is a savior and a source of grace. This name can inspire feelings of faith, courage, and hope, as it serves as a reminder that God is always with us, and we can turn to Him in times of need. Additionally, as an archangel, Susariel is believed to be a guardian and protector, further emphasizing the idea of divine guidance and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Susariel, meaning "Prince of God's Grace," embodies the divine blessings bestowed upon humanity. This name signifies the presence of divine favor and protection, inspiring faith and trust in one's spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: In Jewish and Christian mythology, Susariel is the name of an angel who appears in the apocryphal Book of Enoch and the Zohar.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Susariel continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Michael Susariel in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Susariel, which means "Grace of God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
